Name: Junimos on Island Duty
Author: Pixsio
Description:
[b][color=#9900ff][size=4]Junimos on Island Duty[/size]

A small AI-assisted compatibility patch that helps Better Junimos work with Junimo Huts built on Ginger Island, with optional idle Junimos to make the island farm feel more alive.[/color][/b]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Important Notice[/b][/size]

[i]This mod does not include the convenience features from Better Junimos, nor does it include the ability to build buildings on Ginger Island from Buildable Ginger Island Farm.[/i]It only fixes an issue where, when both of those mods are installed, Junimos may not go out and work properly on Ginger Island in some cases.If you need those features, please download and install the original mods separately.[/color]
[color=#ff7700]
If any original author has concerns, please contact me and I will remove or adjust it. [/color]

[size=4]Features[/size]

- Enables Better Junimos support for Junimo Huts built on Ginger Island.
- Refreshes Better Junimos' hut item cache for Ginger Island huts, so seeds, fertilizer, and other hut items are detected correctly.
- Allows the Better Junimos manual summon key to work on Ginger Island.
- Lets a few idle Junimos wander outside when there is no work to do.
- Keeps the original farm behavior unchanged.

[size=4]Requirements[/size]

- SMAPI
- Better Junimos
- Buildable Ginger Island Farm is recommended if you want to build Junimo Huts on Ginger Island.

[size=4]Tested With[/size]

- Stardew Valley 1.6.15
- SMAPI 4.5.2
- Better Junimos 3.1.2
- Buildable Ginger Island Farm 1.1.4
